               Development Ordinance of the City of Upper Arlington, Ohio, the UDO, the Unified Development
               Ordinance, or just the ordinance.

The authority to adopt this UDO within the City of Upper Arlington, Ohio, is derived
               from the authority provided under Section 15 of the Charter of the City of Upper Arlington,
               Ohio and from the powers granted and limitations imposed by the Ohio Revised Code.
               Whenever the Charter or other laws referenced in this UDO have been amended or superseded,
               this UDO shall be deemed to have been amended in reference to the new or revised Charter
               or other laws.
